risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Catalog, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Logical Data Location
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document the logical location of data and the specific Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) on which the data resides.
compensating_control_1.justification: Logical Data Location (DCH-29) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Data Catalog (DCH-03.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data & Asset Classification
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data & Asset Classification (DCH-04) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Data Catalog (DCH-03.1) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
